lines.trans: Good grief, she keeps saying she is coming—why is she still not here when fireworks start in twenty minutes?!
I walked in and someone phoned saying my headlights were on—wait Joon-mo, I removed my number card, so how did they know my number?
Wait, what are you talking about—if you removed your number, who would call you? Hello?!
Oh gosh, you startled me! Chief Manager Kim, how did you end up out here?
I am sorry—since you would not pick up calls from my own number, Producer…
I was going to call you back later! Wait—did you come out here because of Cindy?
You have Cindy with you right now, after all.
